description: This PHP class defines a Drupal migration source plugin for extracting node type data from a Drupal 6 database, including configuration for comment fields and theme settings.

classes.name: NodeType
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for extracting node type information from Drupal 6 database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query selecting node type fields from the 'node_type' table.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of field descriptions for the node type data, including comment fields if the comment module exists.

methods.name: getCommentFields
methods.description: Returns an array of comment-related field descriptions for a node type.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes class properties with configuration variables for teaser length, node preview, and theme settings.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by setting source properties based on class properties and configuration variables, including comment and menu options.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifier for each node type record, based on the 'type' field.
